summary: Iteration 15 QA of Phase B — job checklists + operations timeline + username login relaxation + unscheduled clock-in flag. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass in 8.67s across 7 classes covering (a) GET /api/assignments/{id}/checklists shape (5 lists × 5 items, warehouse pre-done) + RBAC (owner + Javante allowed; Junior + TestCrew + TestSales all 403), (b) POST toggle endpoint including auto-advance (arrival → Arrived), no-backwards rule (uncheck arrival + toggle warehouse both keep exec_status=Arrived), completed_at set/clear, advanced_to=null when status already >= target, 404 on bad list_key or idx, (c) GET timeline (17+ events, desc-sorted, includes created + status + checklist + clock + crew events; owner + Javante allowed, Junior 403), (d) PATCH /api/assignments emits job_events on crew add/remove/truck change (Hoboken add Junior+Truck2 → verified 'Added to crew: Junior Santil' + 'Truck assigned: Truck 2'; remove → 'Removed from crew: Junior Santil' + 'Truck removed'), (e) dispatch board /api/dispatch/board returns checklist_done + checklist_total=25 on every card (Montclair 15/25 at end), (f) POST /api/users accepts 3+ char username without '@' (login with 'qalogintest'/'haulyeah123' returns token + must_change_password=true), rejects 'has space' → 422, duplicate → 409, DELETE cleanup ok, (g) TestCrewAdmin clock-in with no scheduled job → flags contains 'not_scheduled_today' + owner gets 'flag' notification type with title 'Unscheduled clock-in' + Javante scheduled clock-in has NO flag. Frontend: Owner /dispatch shows 2 progress rings (Montclair 10/25 → 15/25 after loading complete, Hoboken 0/25), dispatch-open-detail opens dispatch-detail-dialog with 17 timeline-events (created, status, checklist, clock, crew, truck) desc-sorted, checklists tab renders all 5 checklist-{key} sections + checklist-item-checkbox toggle updates ring on close/reload. Crew (Javante) /jobs shows job-checklists-toggle-btn → expands job-checklists → completing 'loading' auto-advanced exec_status to 'In Progress' visible after reload. Team tab 'Add a team member' dialog shows label 'Login — username or email' + helper 'Either works — a plain username (3+ characters, no spaces) or a full email address.' + starting password hint 'haulyeah123'. Iter14 regression: 21/23 dispatch tests still pass — the 2 failures (behind count/Montclair behind) are EXPECTED because arrival-checklist auto-advance moved Montclair from En Route to Arrived, and 'behind' logic gates on Assigned/En Route only; not a regression bug.
action_items: Update iter14 test_iteration14_dispatch.py::TestDispatchBoardOwner::test_board_counts_match_qa_state and test_qa_assignments_present_and_behind to no longer assert Montclair 'behind' — with iter15 checklists auto-advancing Montclair to 'Arrived'/'In Progress', it correctly drops out of the behind bucket. Either (a) refactor those two tests to only assert Hoboken behind + counts.behind >= 1, or (b) reset Montclair state before the test class (uncheck arrival checklist + revert exec_status via a fixture).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3018-3050 toggle_checklist_item: correctly re-fetches state after $set to determine all_done (guards against stale doc). completed_at set/cleared idempotently. _apply_exec_status only called when EXEC_STATUSES.index(target) > current — perfect no-backwards guard.

server.py L2869-2906 _apply_exec_status refactor: All Complete side-effects (review_prompted notify, credit_prompted crew credits, timelog sync) preserved. set_job_status now a thin wrapper — clean DRY refactor.
server.py L2965-2971 log_job_event: try/except swallows errors and logs warning — good defensive coding, prevents timeline logging from crashing PATCH/checklist toggles.
server.py L2974-2980 _assignment_for_member_or_owner: owner OR crew-on-job — matches review-request RBAC. 404 on missing / 403 when not on crew. Verified.

server.py L3080-3082 timeline endpoint sorts events desc by 'at' (only items with 'at' included). Uses .to_list(200) for job_events but truncates final events at [:200] — could miss oldest events on long-running jobs, but 200 is generous.

server.py L2438-2439 create_user validation: len>=3 + no spaces — allows plain usernames like 'qalogintest'. Login handler L378-391 uses lowercase(email) as lookup key — case-insensitive as documented.
server.py L3234-3237 unscheduled clock-in owner notify: uses notify(None, 'owner', ...) with type='flag' + title 'Unscheduled clock-in' — matches review-request expectation. Verified via pytest.
server.py L2765-2778 dispatch_board: adds checklist_done + checklist_total=25 to every assignment. _checklist_done_count sums across all 5 lists efficiently.

Dispatch.jsx L312-316: ProgressRing SVG at 10x10 with stroke-dasharray — clean visual, accessible via job-checklist-ring testid. Ring updates after dialog close (board polls every 60s + reloads on dialog close per useEffect dependency).

JobChecklists.jsx L17-18 auto-open first incomplete list on mount — nice UX but caused a QA test-script gotcha (clicking header closes instead of opens when it's already open). Not a bug — behavior matches accordion norms.

JobChecklists.jsx L28-31 shows toast + calls onStatusAdvance() when advanced_to is set → parent (Dispatch/CrewJobs) refetches board — verified end-to-end (Javante saw In Progress badge after completing loading list).

TeamTab.jsx add-user dialog: label 'Login — username or email' + helper text 'Either works — a plain username (3+ characters, no spaces) or a full email address.' — matches ask exactly. Placeholder 'keith2 or name@haulyeahmoves.com' is a nice touch.

rca of the issue: No product bugs. Two iter14 test failures are semantic — the iter15 checklists feature by design moves Montclair out of the 'behind' bucket once arrival/loading auto-advance runs. Fix belongs in the tests, not the code. During UI QA the Junior UI clock-in via localStorage.clear()+re-login race resulted in a stale token read (401) — this only affected my ability to visually verify the crew-unscheduled-badge on the Dispatch crew pool, but the underlying backend flag + owner notify are both proven by pytest, and the badge component exists in Dispatch.jsx L350 with the correct testid + amber styling. Not a product bug.
